findings.issue: History-axis dates are reconstructed from positive-gross box-office history. A degraded production run before any film has grossed records neither box-office nor forecast rows, so its date appears only in that run's rendered page and disappears on the next build. Later history charts then connect across that missing production refresh instead of preserving the required gap.
findings.suggestion: Persist every production refresh date independently of positive grosses and forecasts, and use that durable record when building the history axis.

findings.issue: Season configuration is constructed without validating field types, numeric ranges, or the required `default_wow` categories. Invalid values such as zero trials or a missing category pass loading and fail later through division by zero, NumPy errors, or projection-time `KeyError`, violating the requirement that schemas fail at their load boundary.
findings.suggestion: Validate dates and scalar types, require positive counts and thresholds, and validate both `default_wow` category keys and numeric multiplier ranges before constructing `Season`.
